title: Charged twice for one pair
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. Staff pilot sale (20 pairs). I pressed Buy once, maybe twice because nothing happened, and my card shows two charges of $49.99.
comments: Closed: could not reproduce by clicking once.

title: Double charge again during pilot
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. A second tester has two charges for one order. She clicked once and then refreshed the page while it was loading.

title: One person bought 3 pairs although the limit is one per customer
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. The orders list shows three paid orders for the same email.

title: Sold more pairs than we had
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. Pilot stock was 20 pairs; the orders list shows 37 paid orders.

title: Site went down for everyone for 10 minutes
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. The server stopped during the pilot. The last log line is a SyntaxError from JSON.parse. Restarted by hand.

title: Site crashed again, same error
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. Second outage, the same SyntaxError in the log just before.

title: Restarted the server and two paid orders are gone
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. After the restart in #5, two testers who had paid have no order, but their cards were charged.

title: Order page shows another customer's address
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. I changed the number at the end of my order link and saw someone else's name and address.

title: An order was paid at $0.01
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. One pilot order shows an amount of 1 cent.

title: Card charged but the page said sold out
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. My card was charged $49.99, the page said the pairs were gone, and I have no order.

title: Product page takes more than 5 seconds when the sale opens
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. With about 60 staff on the page at once it took 5 to 8 seconds to load.

title: Buy button spins for half a minute
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. After pressing Buy the button spun for about 30 seconds, then showed an error. The payment provider's status page reported slow responses at that time.

title: Sign-in box still showing after signing in
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. After signing in, the email box and Sign in button are still on the page.

title: Sign-in box doesn't go away on my phone
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. Same as #13, on an Android phone.

title: Error page shows the code's internals
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. A failed purchase showed a long technical error with file names and line numbers.

title: Anyone can open the sales stats page
body: Simulated ticket for the demo. A tester opened the admin stats address without signing in.
